newsitem.title: RUSSIA: BREE rates Russia's Bank Vozrozhdeniye B, LC-2.
newsitem.headline: BREE rates Russia's Bank Vozrozhdeniye B, LC-2.

text.p: Thomson-Bankwatch BREE, which specialises in rating East European banks, has given Bank Vozrozhdeniye a high non-investment grade rating of B, the bank said on Wednesday.
The B rating is in line with the sovereign rating already allocated to Russia.
Vozrozhdeniye received a short-term rating of LC-2, the second highest of four short-term grades used by BREE.
BREE has already allocated the same grades to several major Russian banks.
Vozrozhdeniye is currently preparing an American Depositary Receipt (ADRs) programme.
